subject.title: Bug: reasoning selection can validate against the previous model

question: Does current main enforce the model-before-thinking and send-after-settings invariant across Control UI, macOS, iOS, and Android strongly enough to close this issue, or does a native-client follow-up remain?
rationale: The web documentation describes the desired barrier, but the protected label and missing cross-client source/provenance proof require an owner to confirm whether the complete reported surface is resolved.

options.title: Verify all clients, then close
options.body: Run focused rapid model→thinking→send checks for Control UI and native clients, record the implementing commit, and close if every surface uses the same ordering contract.

options.title: Keep a native-client follow-up
options.body: Confirm the web path is fixed but retain or narrow this issue to whichever macOS, iOS, or Android client still performs independent unordered mutations.

options.title: Accept web-only scope
options.body: Explicitly limit the supported guarantee to Control UI and document native-client behavior separately.

recommendation.title: Verify all clients, then close
recommendation.body: Run focused rapid model→thinking→send checks for Control UI and native clients, record the implementing commit, and close if every surface uses the same ordering contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history trail for provider-owned thinking controls and the affected session-picker behavior points to `steipete`.
